author: GamingBolt
description:
We were thrilled to get to spend a bit of time with Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced, a title that we’ve been very excited about ever since the rumors about its existence began to circulate. Well, it’s as real as it can be now, and our preview experience left us very impressed.

We did try to balance our time between the land and the sea, but we must admit that the Jackdaw made things very hard indeed. That’s because the naval combat in Resynced feels both familiar and fresh. We sailed in a random direction and fired a few shots at the largest and meanest ship we could find. So, what’s changed? Join us and find out!
title: Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced's Naval Combat Could Steal the Show

author: GamingBolt
description:
Well, we've played a reasonably large but curated chunk of Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced, and we've come away quite impressed. It doesn't do too much to change what made out time with Edward Kenway back in the day so special, but the changes it has made are definitely worth stepping on to the jackdaw's deck again.

Join us as we talk about what's good and what isn't with Resynced, and perhaps help you decide if you're going to be treading the fine line between an Assassin and a pirate when the game drops this July.
title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced - 2 Hours In, And I'm Already SOLD

author: GamingBolt
description:
007 First Light’s approach to gadgets is to keep them grounded to ensure they feel practical, but bring fun and replayability too. From the gadgets revealed so far, it’s seems IO Interactive is providing a broad suite of tools and abilities to fit individual playstyles, but they’re so utterly, cinematically Bond that they couldn’t be used in the hands of anyone else (not even IOI’s “other” international assassin). 

With a need to manage resources in loadouts of up to four items, the idea that the studio is pushing for multiple playstyles gains traction. These aren’t infinite-use “Get Out of Jail Free” cards, but tangible tools which shape gameplay in meaningful ways. So now, let’s break down every gadget revealed so far.
title: 007 First Light - Every Gadget Revealed So Far And What It Does
